steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13)

steps.name: assert-flag-on-simple
steps.failMessage: walkWindowFixtures should be ON in default Simple mode (simple tier, default true)

steps.name: assert-orbit-inert

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find(i => i.id === 'default-ld-curtain'); return it && it.props.drawAmount === 1 })()

steps.failMessage: Pressing E in ORBIT mode must NOT toggle the curtain (walk-only interact gate; toggle is synchronous so drawAmount would already be 0)

steps.name: enter-walk-overlay-shown
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash never appeared, so the gone-wait below would pass vacuously. If this transition genuinely raises no splash (same mode, or the room editor owns the overlay) delete BOTH guard steps rather than widening the timeout.

steps.name: enter-walk-overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash still up; the next screenshot would capture the splash, not the scene. See docs/visual-verification-playbook.md.

steps.name: aim-loop-detects-curtain
steps.failMessage: FirstPersonCamera's real aim loop should set nearbyFixtureId to the living/dining curtain

steps.name: prompt-says-open
steps.failMessage: FixturePrompt should read 'Open curtains' while the curtain is drawn

steps.name: curtain-toggled-open

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find(i => i.id === 'default-ld-curtain'); return it && it.props.drawAmount === 0 })()

steps.failMessage: The real E-key handler should flip the aimed curtain's drawAmount to 0

steps.name: prompt-says-close
steps.failMessage: FixturePrompt should flip to 'Close curtains' once open

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find(i => i.id === 'default-ld-curtain'); return it && it.props.drawAmount === 1 })()
